verifications.note: DTE's FERC pre-filing request letter (Oct 2016), Sec. 3.i 'Project Route': 'The mainline route includes construction of approximately 14 miles of up to 16-inch-diameter pipeline that originates in Oley Township, Berks County, Pennsylvania, and terminates near the Borough of Birdsboro, Berks County, Pennsylvania.' Exact match to recorded StartLocation=Oley / EndLocation=Birdsboro, both PA.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Value as recorded (Oley -> Birdsboro, PA) is stated verbatim in DTE's Oct-2016 FERC pre-filing letter (already staged on this row for Pressure/Proposal). IMPORTANT CONFLICT FOUND: two later, more authoritative descriptions of the AS-CERTIFIED/AS-BUILT route instead name the receipt point as Rockland Township, not Oley Township -- (1) the FERC Order Issuing Certificate, 162 FERC P61,238 (Mar 15 2018, docket CP17-409, already staged on this row): 'extending from a single receipt point on Texas Eastern's pipeline in Rockland Township, Berks County, Pennsylvania, to a single delivery point at a new 485-megawatt... facility... in Birdsboro, Pennsylvania'; (2) marcellusdrilling.com's Jun-2018 and Dec-2018 articles (both already staged on this row) both describe the pipeline as running 'from the Texas Eastern Transmission (Tetco) mainline in Rockland Township... to a natural gas-fired power plant... in Birdsboro'; neither mentions Oley as the origin. The FERC Order does discuss Oley Township at length (paras 96, emphasis added elsewhere) but only as a township the ROUTE CROSSES (an 18-inch Oley Township sewer line crossed by HDD; Oley Township Historic District impacts; early public meetings held in Oley Township per the pre-filing letter) -- never as the receipt/origin point in the final description. This reads as a route detail that shifted between the initial Oct-2016 proposal (Oley Township origin) and the Dec-2017/Mar-2018 FERC certificate + as-built pipeline (Rockland Township origin), both townships being adjacent in Berks County. Flagging for validity review: StartLocation may need updating from 'Oley' to 'Rockland Township' (or the record kept as-is with this caveat) -- did not overwrite since a source does state the recorded value exactly; second independent source could not be found stating 'Oley' as the origin (dtmidstream.com's asset page and the FactSheet/FAQ PDFs give only 'Berks County' generically, no township named).

SHEET-CONTRADICTING FINDING, not a plain no-source case: searched dtmidstream.com/asset/birdsboro-pipeline/ (already staged), the FERC Order Issuing Certificate 162 FERC P61,238 (already staged), the Oct-2016 DTE FERC pre-filing letter (already staged), DTE's 'Birdsboro Pipeline Project' fact sheet (newlook.dteenergy.com/.../BirdsboroFactSheet.pdf, newly fetched), DTE's 'Birdsboro Pipeline Project Q&A' (newlook.dteenergy.com/.../BirdsboroPipelineFAQs.pdf, newly fetched), and both marcellusdrilling.com articles (already staged) -- none states that Birdsboro Power owns the pipeline. Every one instead describes DTE Midstream Appalachia, LLC (a wholly-owned subsidiary of DTE Pipeline Company / indirect subsidiary of DTE Energy) as the entity that proposed, built, owns and operates the Birdsboro Pipeline under FERC Docket CP17-409, and describes Birdsboro Power, LLC as the pipeline's SOLE ANCHOR SHIPPER/CUSTOMER -- it 'has contracted for 100 percent of the capacity of the Birdsboro Pipeline, pursuant to a Precedent Agreement dated August 19, 2016' (FERC Order para. 4) -- and separately as the DEVELOPER/OWNER of the destination Birdsboro power plant (dtmidstream.com: the power plant 'is owned by Birdsboro Power LLC'; FERC Order paras 61/936: 'Birdsboro Power's Birdsboro Power Facility'). The Q&A PDF states plainly: 'Who is building the Birdsboro Pipeline? DTE Gas Storage & Pipelines has reached an agreement to build [it]... to serve a new 485-megawatt power plant being developed by EmberClear and backed by private equity firm Ares Management' -- again DTE as builder/pipeline owner, EmberClear/Ares as the plant developer/owner chain that Birdsboro Power LLC sits under. No source found supports the recorded Owner1='Birdsboro Power' 100% for the PIPELINE ITSELF -- it appears to conflate the power plant's owner / the pipeline's sole shipper with the pipeline's owner. Recommend routing to Update: sheet Owner1 likely should be 'DTE Midstream Appalachia, LLC' (or its DTE Energy/DTE Pipeline Company parent per GEM's owner-attribution convention), with Birdsboro Power left off the pipeline Owner field or reclassified as Shipper/end-user context in ResearcherNotes. Leaving current value un-sourced (UNRESOLVED) rather than fabricating a ref for a value the evidence contradicts.
